grok_first_pass.major_disagreement: First pass dropped two rocks and Walking Ballista; did not compare Basalt, Module, or Pit.

design.identity: Copy non-mana activated artifact/creature abilities with sacrifice in their activation costs; recursive artifacts, fodder generation, extra turns and sacrifice payoffs, with specific Ashnod commander-dependent infinite lines.
design.anti_homogenization: Basalt's two artifact-loop synergies and the Pit/Module sacrifice/token loops are selected for this deck's existing engine, not to insert a generic Grixis combo package. No Thassa's Oracle/Consultation package.

swaps.reason: The Goblin Engineer + Lotus Petal + Monitor loop actually uses Ashnod's copy, creates repeatable artifact/creature death and ETBs, and Monitor untaps key artifacts even outside the combo. Inspector was the third reducer; two remain.

Missed by first-pass M7: one card unlocks TWO independent two-card colorless-infinite combos with existing Rings of Brighthearth or Forensic Gadgeteer (Spellbook 4131-4235 and 4131-5390), plus triples mana once without combo. The deck keeps Walking Ballista to convert colorless mana into a win.

Both sacrifice abilities are copied by Ashnod: bounce up to two target creatures for U or draw two for 1. Replaces the most replaceable color Talisman; 33 lands/8 rocks plus more reliable untapped rainbow lands mitigate the one-rock loss.

Two-mana free repeatable artifact activated sacrifice outlet; Ashnod copies its charge-counter ability. Along with Crime Novelist, a creature to start, and 1 mana if that creature is not an artifact, it can repeat sacrificing the newly made artifact Spawn, adding two Pit counters, getting R from Novelist and spending R to replace the Spawn. New manually derived Ashnod-specific death/ETB/sacrifice loop. Duplicator's late end-step copying remains a real opportunity cost.

One-mana Urza's Saga target, exploits Novelist's counters and already-present Arcbound Ravager/Ashnod's Altar/KCI. Commander Spellbook independently lists three near-complete three-card combos with exactly Module missing: 2829-3490-5346, 2034-3490-5346, 3490-4659-5346. Fireweaver is a reliable damage payoff, but several other sacrifice-win outlets remain.

Ashnod copies targeted Priest ability after two other creatures are sacrificed: each selected opponent may lose 4/sacrifice two creatures and we receive BBBB plus two draws. This trades unconditional 4-MV historic-card draw for a 2-MV commander-doubled mana, removal and draw engine.

Ruthless is 3 MV and immediately turns 2B plus one creature into four Treasure tokens with Ashnod; sacrificing three Treasures to Knave's second ability draws two instead of one. Farid's nontoken-death Scrap production, rummaging and one Deathmantle combo are meaningful losses, but Knave's mana and no-tap doubled draw better support this token-sacrifice build.
Immediate unconditional three-color mana avoids a turn-tapped land for casting UBR five-mana Ashnod; pay one damage when tapped, forgo cycling.
Guarantees all Ashnod colors independently of opponents' land types, at one life per colored tap; improving commander access outweighs the life cost in this high-power shell.

independent_manual_rules_case.requires: A creature to sacrifice initially; if nonartifact, 1 starting generic mana; opponent interaction can interrupt; Ashnod and Crime Novelist remain in play.
independent_manual_rules_case.line: Activate Spawning Pit sacrificing the creature. Ashnod copies the nonmana ability; both counters resolve for two charges. Create a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature for 1. Sacrifice that Spawn to the first Pit ability: two charges again, Crime Novelist adds R. Spend that R to create the next Spawn; loop. No infinite mana claim.

mana.note: These are hypergeometric access probabilities, NOT calibrated multiplayer win rates; ignore rituals, opponent interaction, and colored availability. Two fully untapped guaranteed UBR land replacements offset some reliability cost from one fewer static rock. Includes one-shot Lotus Petal and conditional Mox Opal/Basalt in the source-card proxy; not a cast-probability or win-rate model.
